fields.Name: T151 - Form Builder Forms List Tree View Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the FormsViewMode 'list' vs 'tree' branch (treeGroups schema/entity grouping) — a distinct rendering path from the flat forms list.

InputDefinition.goal: In Component Studio → Form Studio, find the view-mode toggle button in the Forms rail header (a list/folder-tree icon, tooltip 'Switch to tree view (Schema → Entity → Form)'). Click it to switch the forms list from the flat list into the grouped tree view. Verify the list re-groups by Schema → Entity → Form (schema headers with database icons, entity sub-groups with per-entity form counts) — or, if there are no forms, that a clean empty state is shown. Toggle back to the flat list to confirm it round-trips. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the list restructure between flat and tree layouts is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking the forms-list view toggle switches between the flat list and a Schema → Entity → Form grouped tree
The tree view shows schema group headers and entity sub-groups with form counts (or a valid empty state if no forms exist)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
